name: your-vote-costs-50
why: Opens on the 1-in-60-million odds, kills YOU on the drive and has his skeleton vote anyway, rings up $50 against a $0.000338 coin the dog eats, and pays off with the corporation's tape of plus signs running past him (49 s).

name: a-dog-that-already-sits

name: step-zero-have-no-enemies
